answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake and build a verifiable work history before it can earn rewards. A new identity starts with no reputation, like an ember that must be tended before it gives heat, and cannot vote or claim large payouts until peers attest sustained useful work. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real locked capital plus time, while a single honest agent passes easily. Like marble, reputation is hard to carve quickly but easy to check, and like water through karst, cheap fakes drain away before reaching rewards.
